family: Original minimal interface sound for a calm private messaging app. Soft rounded glass and airy felt mallet texture, warm, clean, understated, no harsh frequencies, no hiss, no voice, no music, no recognizable brand melody. Low-intensity intimate sound, clean silence around the effect.

effects.name: message
effects.prompt: One soft rising two-note droplet, incoming message. Fast gentle attack and very short decay.

effects.name: sent
effects.prompt: One soft tiny upward pluck and airy flick, message sent, shorter and quieter than an incoming alert.

effects.name: coin
effects.prompt: Two warm rounded glass notes, quietly positive, wallet funds received and confirmed. No metallic cash register.

effects.name: confirmed
effects.prompt: One warm low pluck resolving into a softer high note, wallet payment completed. Calm confirmation.

effects.name: request
effects.prompt: One light bright register ding, a single small rounded bell tap, a payment request arrived. Not a droplet.
effects.edit: take 3 of 6; gain +3.0 dB to -18 LUFS; fade out from 0.32 s

effects.name: ring
effects.prompt: A gentle three-note invitation to an incoming call, followed by generous silence, suitable for repeating. Soft marimba-like glass, not alarming.

effects.name: ringback
effects.prompt: One low soft resonant pulse followed by generous silence, waiting for a call to be answered.

effects.name: hangup
effects.prompt: Two very soft descending rounded plucks, a call has ended, calm and brief.

effects.name: connected
effects.prompt: Two gentle glass taps, one from each side, then a soft upward resolution. Peaceful, reassuring, connected. Short clean fade.

effects.name: paid
effects.prompt: A short soft outgoing whoosh carrying one small rounded glass coin away, payment sent. Brief airy tail.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain +5.8 dB to -18 LUFS

effects.name: realmoney
effects.prompt: One deeper serious wooden tick, low and firm, a considered confirmation. Very short and dry.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain +7.2 dB to -18 LUFS

effects.name: testcoins
effects.prompt: A tiny playful jingle of three small toy coins, light plastic and glass, cheerful and quick.
effects.edit: take 2 of 3; gain +1.1 dB to -18 LUFS

effects.name: failed
effects.prompt: One soft short low muted bonk, gentle and forgiving, something did not go through. Rounded, not alarming.
effects.edit: take 2 of 3; gain -0.6 dB to -19 LUFS

effects.name: sealed
effects.prompt: One soft stamp and seal thunk, a warm felt stamp pressed on paper, verified. Low, round, satisfying.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain +3.3 dB to -18 LUFS

effects.name: shared
effects.prompt: A quick soft card flip, one paper card turning over with an airy flutter. Light and brief.
effects.edit: take 1 of 6; gain +4.8 dB to -20 LUFS; fade out from 0.32 s

effects.name: checked
effects.prompt: One bright small glass check tick, rising and clean, verification done. Crisp but soft, very short.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain +5.9 dB to -19 LUFS

effects.name: knock
effects.prompt: Two soft wooden knocks on a small door, knock-knock, friendly and quiet, someone arrived. Rounded, close.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain +2.0 dB to -18 LUFS

effects.name: switched
effects.prompt: A very subtle soft airy swoosh passing by, barely there, a quiet change of route. Faint and brief.
effects.edit: take 3 of 3; gain +3.7 dB to -24 LUFS

effects.name: back
effects.prompt: One soft rounded rising blip, small and calm, connection restored. Very short, gentle glass.
effects.edit: take 2 of 3; gain -2.1 dB to -20 LUFS

effects.name: mention
effects.prompt: Two quick bright rising glass notes with a small sparkle, someone called your name. A bit more present than a droplet.
effects.edit: take 5 of 6; gain +1.5 dB to -16 LUFS

effects.name: spoiler
effects.prompt: One small soft bubble pop, playful and round, hidden text revealed. Very short, no splash.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain -3.6 dB to -20 LUFS

effects.name: downloaded
effects.prompt: One short bright plim, a single small glass pluck, a file finished downloading. Clean and tiny.
effects.edit: take 1 of 3; gain +2.4 dB to -20 LUFS

effects.name: deleted
effects.prompt: A soft ghostly fwip fading downward, a breathy airy sweep that dissolves away. Gentle, not sad.
effects.edit: take 4 of 6; gain +3.3 dB to -20 LUFS

effects.name: slide
effects.prompt: A very quiet soft card slide, one paper card gliding across felt, barely audible. Short and smooth.
effects.edit: take 3 of 3; gain -10.5 dB to -26 LUFS

effects.name: flip
effects.prompt: A quiet soft card flip, one card turning over with a light paper flutter. Short and clean.
effects.edit: take 2 of 3; gain -2.3 dB to -24 LUFS; fade out from 0.32 s

effects.name: wallet
effects.prompt: A short soft cha-ching, a tiny rounded glass bell and one coin, a new wallet. Warm, small, not metallic.
effects.edit: take 6 of 6; gain -4.7 dB to -18 LUFS

effects.name: group
effects.prompt: A quick soft ghostly chorus, three airy glass tones rising together like a tiny wordless choir. Warm, brief.
effects.edit: take 6 of 6; gain -2.4 dB to -18 LUFS
